answer: Sealed marble lottery. Each agent gets one identity by submitting a secret commit; a public verifiable-randomness beacon later draws a seed. Only commits whose hash falls in a narrow band win, and the band is unknown until the seed is revealed. An attacker can't precompute favorable commits. Winning agents join a sable cohort and gain voting weight; losers wait a full epoch. Sybils must flood thousands of commits per retained identity, and each commit costs a small fee plus the opportunity cost of a hollow epoch with no income.
